description: A quantiser and chord generator that follows klezmer modes, with a chord section on four jacks and two independent lead voices

params.text: Picks the root note of the mode, in semitones
Picks the mode: Freygish, Mi Sheberach, Adonai Malakh, Magein Avot or Harmonic Minor
Selects that degree of the mode as the chord being played
Picks how the chord is spaced: Close, Drop 2, Drop 3 or Open
Picks which note of the chord is at the bottom: root position, first or second inversion
Sets how much of that lead's pitch input is used before the note is quantised
Shifts that lead by whole octaves
Shifts that lead by a fixed number of scale degrees, two either way
Switches that lead's gate jack between a short trigger on each new note and a gate held for as long as the note lasts

inputs.text: Moves the root note of the mode, a tenth of the knob's travel per volt
Moves the mode selection, a tenth of the knob's travel per volt
Selects the chord degree from a voltage instead of the buttons
The pitch that lead quantises to the chord, scaled by that lead's amount knob
Shifts that lead by octaves on top of its octave switch

outputs.text: A trigger or a gate, as that lead's switch is set, whenever that lead lands on a new note
The root of the mode two octaves down, for a pedal note
The root of the chord being played, an octave below the voices
The chord's notes together on one polyphonic cable
The second note of the chord
The third note of the chord
A 5V gate while that chord button is held
